name: astro-3d
description: 13 skills for 3D on the web with three.js r186 and React Three Fiber 9: scenes, cameras and renderers, geometry and instancing, PBR materials, lighting and shadows, textures, animation, glTF loading, shaders and TSL, post-processing, interaction, performance and the glTF asset pipeline (Draco, meshopt, KTX2), on WebGL or WebGPU.
